title.en: Core Concepts of Exchange Rate Policy
title.hi: Core Concepts of Exchange Rate Policy

content.en: Exchange rate policy is the strategy used by a government or central bank to influence the **exchange rate** of its currency. In India, the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** manages the exchange rate to prevent excessive volatility rather than targeting a specific fixed rate. This is known as a **Managed Float** system. The policy aims to balance the needs of exporters and importers while maintaining overall **macroeconomic stability**.

title.en: Nominal vs Real Effective Exchange Rate
title.hi: Nominal vs Real Effective Exchange Rate

content.en: NEER is the weighted average of bilateral nominal exchange rates, while REER adjusts NEER for inflation differentials.
